column4: dialect-gated per SUBTEST: cleat#2244's reclaim-race regression test (PR #2815) runs 5 configurations -- postgres, mysql, mysql_read_committed, mssql_rcsi_on, mssql_rcsi_off. This job sets only CLEAT_TEST_DB (Postgres), so postgres RUNS and the other four skip.
